title: Mark each model answer with its rubric
statement: Mark every model answer or reveal with the rubric it models before it ships.
detail: In a Grade 3 reading course, one written response's rubric required a term that its own model answer expressed in other words, so the model answer would have been marked down by the rule printed under it; no check had opened the strings, only counted them (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/courses/g3-reading/iteration-3/CONTENT-FAILURE-CLASSES.md`, class 8). The check added since scores every model answer against its own criteria. The course's assessment memo also asks each written response to declare its pass mark and carry a borderline example at that mark, not only a top-score model, so a pass is anchored where the decision is hard; at the time its examples were top-score only (`grade3-reading/ti-courseplans/courses/g3-reading/iteration-2/approval-package-v2/sources/ASSESSMENT-QUALITY-MEMO.md`).

evidence.quote: U2-L6's SCR required the term "sacrifice"; its own model answer said "gave up".
scores every exemplar against its own criteria. Nothing else in the battery opened the strings
